Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Master of Decay
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Necromancy/Thanatosis
+1 stealth action.
[nec]  Take control of a ghoul wraith or zombie ally controlled by another Methuselah.
[thn] Add a pathos counter to each card you control with at least 1 pathos counter on it.
[THN]  Put 2 pathos counter and this card on an ally, equipment or retainer. During your untap phase, burn 1 pathos counter on this ally, equipment or retainer. Remove it from the game if it has no pathos counters. (Cards with pathos counters burn 1 counter during their controller's untap phase, and are removed from play when they have no pathos counters.)

This cards enforces the pathos strategy of the Samedi (Reanimated Corpses mainly... ok that's pretty much all) and gives them a polyvalent way to remove annoying threats on the table (though with a little delay).

Prince of Paris, France

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body: I am not sure it is worth a blood. You can already spend an extra blood to give the corpse an extra Pathos counter when you recruit it, and playing Master of Decay takes an extra action. If you loosely count 1 blood = 1 action, you are at a net loss if you play the card with only 1 corpse in play, you break even at 2 corpses and you only start to see a net gain at 3 corpses.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981

Edited from the original to allay some of the worries about Pathos Counters.

Name: Master of Decay
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Necromancy/Thanatosis
+1 stealth action.
[nec] Take control of a ghoul wraith or zombie ally controlled by another Methuselah.
[thn] Add a pathos counter to each card you control with at least 1 pathos counter on it.
[THN] Put 2 pathos counter and this card on an ally, equipment or retainer. If no pathos counters were burned from the ally, equipment or retainer with this card during the since the beginning of your last turn, burn a pathos counter on this card.

This should mean that if it burned any during your last turn, it protects it from burning twice.
